response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with nearly two decades of experience, but the role calls for a director-level AI strategy principal engineer with deep AI/ML expertise, recognized thought leadership, and experience advising strategic customers on cutting-edge AI adoption. His experience is broad but generalist (web, mobile, embedded, GIS), with only recent and shallow exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators), no advanced AI/ML degree, and no evidence of building recognized AI products, platforms, or advising enterprise customers on AI strategy.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year engineering career across many domains (web, mobile, embedded, backend)
Demonstrated technical depth and craftsmanship (TDD, open-source libraries, low-latency systems)
Some recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at current role
concerns: No advanced degree or demonstrated deep expertise in AI/ML as preferred
Lack of evidence of building or leading recognized AI products/platforms
No indication of experience advising strategic customers/partners or operating at director/strategy level

key_factors.factor: Insufficient AI/ML depth and recognized expertise
No strategic customer advisory or director-level leadership experience
Strong general engineering breadth and craftsmanship
